subject: Commercial readout & sponsor decision anchors
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@healthgrid.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@healthgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: commercial readout & next steps

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick readout and asks from my side so we have a single source of truth before I brief the CFO.

Key pain & goals (as discussed)
- Current inference costs for our realtime recommendations pipeline are 3–4x estimate; main driver is small batch sizes and high tail-latency.
- We need 95th percentile latency under 120ms for <500ms total response to our product flows.
- Goal: reduce per-query cost by 40% and eliminate expensive manual scaling incidents.

Business outcomes for HealthGrid leadership
- Lower inference costs to meet Q4 margin targets.
- Maintain or improve model quality (no measurable regression on NPS).
- Predictable procurement path with an enterprise SLA.

Immediate asks
1) Can Redwood provide a one-page commercial summary (SLA, price bands, reserved capacity options) we can share with procurement and finance?
2) Draft SOW / scope for a 3-month pilot and high-level timeline for production rollout.
3) A single list of security/compliance items procurement will escalate (SOC2 evidence, VPC options, KMS details).

Open risk flags I flagged on the call
- Data residency for EU customers in our mix (we will need regional routing).
- Backup/fallback plan if dedicated capacity is constrained during peak.

I'll loop procurement and Tom will add priorities from finance. Please confirm the next steps and attach the commercial summary so I can move this to procurement.

Claire
Claire Huang
Sr. Director, Data Platforms
HealthGrid

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: commercial readout & next steps

Claire — thanks for the clear synthesis. Short reply with a concrete plan from our side and owners.

Readout summary (Redwood lens)
- Root causes: small moment-to-moment batch sizes + tail latency amplification from upstream retries; current model variant is CPU/FP32 heavy and would benefit from quantized GPU serving and smarter routing.
- Outcome we can commit to for pilot: 95th pctl token latency <= 120ms on dedicated pool at your 60% traffic baseline; estimated cost reduction 30–45% depending on batch profile.

What we will deliver by Friday (owner)
- Commercial one-pager: price bands (hosted vs dedicated vs private), SLAs, and basic SSO/KMS notes — Sean Gallagher (owner).
- Draft 3-month pilot SOW with milestones (enablement, pilot run, evaluation, ramp) — Marissa Cole (owner).
- Security/compliance checklist with SOC2 and VPC/KMS evidence pointers — Karthik Iyer (owner).

Procurement path & timing
- Recommended: pilot under a short-term reserved capacity agreement (90 days) with optional conversion to a committed Dedicated seat package.
- Procurement will need: (1) commercial one-pager, (2) SOW, (3) standard contract + redlines window (we recommend 10 business days).

Escalation lanes
- If latency SLOs are missed during the pilot, Redwood will provide a technical mitigation plan and prioritized remediation (kernel/update/variant swap) within 48 hours.
- For legal/contract exceptions beyond standard T&Cs (data residency, HIPAA addendum), please escalate to your legal lead and we'll loop Redwood legal — we can draft a limited addendum quickly.

Attachments:
- "2026-09-23-healthgrid-sow-draft.pdf" (draft SOW template for pilot)
- "healthgrid-procurement-checklist.xlsx" (procurement evidence checklist, redwood internal)

Next proposed touchpoints
- Internal procurement readout (HealthGrid + Redwood commercial) — Thu Sep 24, 11:00 AM PT (30 min) — please confirm.
- Technical kickoff (post-procurement sign) — week of Oct 4.

I'll circulate the one-pager and SOW by EOD. If Tom or procurement want a different cadence, tell us and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@healthgrid.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: commercial readout & next steps

Looping in a very short checklist from enablement/ops to make the procurement handoff smooth. I also added a couple of small clarifying questions for Claire to confirm scope assumptions.

Enablement checklist (pre-pilot) — quick items we will include in SOW
- Data ingress: confirm expected peak qps and 99th percentile batch sizes (we will provide a lightweight profiler script).
- Model versioning: will HealthGrid bring your model weights or use Redwood-verified open model + finetune layer? Need confirmation.
- Regional routing: EU traffic will be routed to eu-dedicated pool; note this affects pricing bands.

Questions for HealthGrid
1) For the pilot, do you want Redwood to host model weights in a private VPC or use our hosted model registry (we can support both)?
2) Who is the legal point of contact for redlines? (name + email)

Attachments included
- 2026-09-23-healthgrid-sow-draft.pdf (pdf, 82KB) — draft SOW (pilot scope + milestones).
- healthgrid-procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 14KB) — procurement evidence matrix.

Proposed next step: brief procurement for 30 minutes tomorrow at 11:00 AM PT; Sean will send calendar invite. If procurement needs a pre-read, we can package the one-pager + SOW into a single PDF and share.

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
